string: S2RB uses the microphone only for on-device agent environment safety assessment, such as acoustic level checks before a handshake. Audio never leaves this device.
S2RB uses the camera to scan a local QR code that points at a household host on the LAN. The image is not uploaded.
S2RB discovers S2 hosts on the local network so a phone can open the genesis page without sending the topology to the cloud.
S2RB may read coarse location only to label a SITE doorplate the user is editing. Coordinates are not sent with failed DID probes.
